skills.name: Cabbage Harvest!
skills.description: Sacrifices (?) self to block cabbage attacks. Good effects on allies.  *HP +300% (10 sec) *Skill Resistance +35% (10 sec) *HP x 35% Area Recovery (per sec) (10 sec)

skills.name: Here I Go!
skills.description: Runs around enough bombs to destroy a town. Bad effects on enemies.  *Cancels enemy invincibility skills  *ATK x 3500% Area Damage  *Enemy knockback

abilities.name: Group: KONOSUBA
abilities.description: KONOSUBA Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and HP buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Revive
abilities.description: Rangers will have a high chance of being revived when they are defeated. Rangers will be revived with 70% HP. This Ability will only activate once.
